task_context.problem_statement: Every morning, Jason eats an omelet made using three eggs.  How many eggs will Jason consume in two weeks?
task_context.reference_solution:
Two weeks is 7*2=<<7*2=14>>14 days.
If Jason eats three eggs per day for two weeks, then he consumes 3*14=<<3*14=42>>42 eggs.
#### 42
